from: Erongo Tanning treats 3 000 hides a month. It sells each finished hide at N$320, of which N$130 is the bought-in hide and chemicals. A closed-loop water and chemical recovery system would cost N$1 500 000, cut effluent trucking to N$18 000 a month, and reduce bought-in chemicals by N$14 a hide, but would take four months to install, during which output would fall by a third. Analyse the impact of the system on the business and recommend whether Erongo should install it.
to: Erongo Tanning treats 3 000 hides a month. It sells each finished hide at N$320, of which N$130 is the bought-in hide and chemicals.
